returned_textual_content: # Create an Analytics report Creating a new Analytics Report is as simple as two clicks. {% hint style="warning" %} You will only be able to create Analytics Reports if you are an Owner of a Data Domain. {% endhint %} First, go to your list of Analytics Reports by expanding the tile on your Data Domain landing page. Then click `+ CREATE` at the top-right corner of the expanded list of Analytics Reports. {% hint style="success" %} If there are no Analytics Reports in a Data Domain, you can create your first one directly from the Data Domain homepage. {% endhint %} When you create a new report, you will be taken to the `Tiles` page, which will be empty until you [create metrics](/data-domains/analytics-reports/create-and-edit-metrics) and use them to [create tiles](/data-domains/analytics-reports/create-and-analyse-charts). An Analytics Report is made up of three sections: * **Tiles** - Displays charts and infographics created in the report and enables you to edit them. * **Metrics** - Lists metrics you have created in this report and enables you to create and edit them. * **Settings** - Contains sections for editing the name and description of the report or deleting it.
